title.original: K-Search: LLM Kernel Generation via Co-Evolving Intrinsic World Model
title.zh: K-Search：通过共同演化内在世界模型生成LLM内核
title.en: K-Search: LLM Kernel Generation via Co-Evolving Intrinsic World Model

inclusion_reason.zh: K-Search 提供带世界模型、计划—实例化分离、编译验证和性能反馈的自动 kernel 搜索系统，而非一次性生成算法。
inclusion_reason.en: K-Search provides an automated kernel-search system with a world model, planning/instantiation separation, compile validation, and performance feedback rather than one-shot generation.

abstract.zh: K-Search 用与候选程序共同演化的内在世界模型指导 GPU kernel 搜索，把高层优化规划与低层代码实例化分离，以跨越暂时变慢或错误的非单调搜索路径。
abstract.en: K-Search guides GPU-kernel search with an intrinsic world model that co-evolves with candidate programs, separating high-level optimization planning from low-level code instantiation to traverse non-monotonic paths.

problem.zh: 把 LLM 仅当随机代码生成器的进化搜索缺少多步规划，复杂结构变换中的临时错误会让有潜力的方向过早被淘汰。
problem.en: Evolutionary search that treats an LLM only as a stochastic coder lacks multi-step planning, so temporary defects during structural transformations prematurely discard promising directions.

approach.zh: 世界模型积累优化空间知识并提出高层计划，代码生成器负责实例化；两者随编译、正确性和性能反馈共同更新，允许保留尚未完成的策略。
approach.en: A world model accumulates optimization-space knowledge and proposes plans, a code generator instantiates them, and both evolve from compile, correctness, and performance feedback while retaining unfinished strategies.

system_design.zh: 搜索状态包含计划、kernel 候选和实验反馈；规划器选择结构变换，实例化器生成代码，验证/基准执行器回传结果供世界模型和种群更新。
system_design.en: Search state holds plans, kernel candidates, and experiment feedback; a planner chooses structural transformations, an instantiator writes code, and validation plus benchmarking update the world model and population.

key_results.zh: 在多类 FlashInfer 复杂 kernel 与独立任务上，K-Search 优于既有进化方法，并找到超过若干人工实现的方案。
key_results.en: Across several complex FlashInfer kernels and an independent task, K-Search outperforms prior evolutionary methods and discovers implementations that beat multiple human-designed solutions.

limitations.zh: 结果依赖模型先验、编译器和目标 GPU，搜索仍消耗大量验证计算；通过测试不等于形式正确，世界模型也可能过拟合已见 kernel。
limitations.en: Results depend on model priors, compiler, and target GPU, while search consumes substantial validation compute; passing tests is not formal correctness, and the world model may overfit seen kernels.

models: large language models used for kernel generation

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
